{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoints without stated analysis",
      "quote": "Proportion of patients with improvement (reduction) of weekly average of daily hand and foot peak Pruritus NRS ≥3 from baseline to week 16",
      "page": 40,
      "section": "4.1.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "This secondary endpoint is listed but no statistical analysis method is described for it in the statistical plan.",
      "fix": "Add analysis methods for all secondary endpoints, including this one."
    },
    {
      "title": "Primary estimand missing population attribute",
      "quote": "The primary estimand of interest, the intercurrent event(s) strategy, and missing data handling methods for the primary endpoint (binary response) are described in Table 2.",
      "page": 86,
      "section": "11.4.3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand table does not explicitly state the population attribute (e.g., FAS) for the primary estimand.",
      "fix": "Specify the population (e.g., FAS) in the estimand table."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of intercurrent events for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "Endpoints are listed in Section 4 Analysis variables are listed in Section 5. Handling of missing data due to the COVID-19 pandemic and any additional analyses required to investigate the impact of COVID-19 to understand estimated treatment effect and safety will be detailed in the SAP.",
      "page": 84,
      "section": "11",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan only describes intercurrent event strategies for the primary endpoint; no strategies are described for secondary endpoints.",
      "fix": "Define intercurrent event strategies for all secondary endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size power statement incomplete",
      "quote": "sample size will yield >95% power to detect a treatment difference of 24% in the proportion of",
      "page": 84,
      "section": "11.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The sentence is cut off; the sample size section is incomplete, missing the full power calculation details and assumptions.",
      "fix": "Complete the sample size section with full details."
    },
    {
      "title": "No multiplicity adjustment described for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "For comparison of dupilumab treatment to placebo, the following hypothesis of the primary endpoint will be tested:",
      "page": 84,
      "section": "11.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan does not describe any multiplicity control for the multiple secondary endpoints.",
      "fix": "Add a section on multiplicity adjustment for secondary endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for exploratory endpoints",
      "quote": "In patients with AD lesions on other parts of the body in addition to hands and feet; − Percent change in EASI score from baseline to week 16",
      "page": 41,
      "section": "4.1.4",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Exploratory endpoints are listed but no analysis methods are described for them in the statistical plan.",
      "fix": "Add analysis methods for exploratory endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent handling of missing data for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "Sensitivity analysis using the last observation carried forward (LOCF) approach or the worst observation carried forward (WOCF) approach to determine patient’s status at week 16 will be conducted",
      "page": 86,
      "section": "11.4.3.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The primary analysis uses non-responder imputation, but sensitivity analyses use LOCF/WOCF; the choice of sensitivity analysis may not be consistent with the primary estimand.",
      "fix": "Clarify the sensitivity analysis strategy and its alignment with the estimand."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for safety endpoint",
      "quote": "Incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) through week 16",
      "page": 40,
      "section": "4.1.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The safety endpoint is listed but no statistical analysis method is described for it.",
      "fix": "Add analysis methods for safety endpoints."
    }
  ]
}
